corrections.text: The headline and summary say MongoDB 9.0.4 was faster 'than 8.0 and 8.3'. According to Percona's November 6 post, the test compared MongoDB Community 9.0.4 with Percona Server for MongoDB 8.0.34-15 and 8.3.13-4, not MongoDB's own 8.0 and 8.3 builds; Percona states that those builds come from the same upstream code and that no Percona-specific features were enabled. Percona's text also gives 'about 6%' as a single figure for the CPU-bound case and does not break it down per comparator.
